retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key portrait featuring a central subject in a noir-inspired setting with vibrant, expressive hand-drawn typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a man seated at a table with playing cards and bottles, illuminated by harsh side-lighting that casts dramatic shadows of venetian blinds. The image is framed by a thick black border containing expressive, handwritten text in contrasting colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a background of rhythmic horizontal shadows
Vibrant yellow script at the top contrasting with white script at the bottom
Warm skin tones and table elements against a deep black negative space
The subject's direct gaze anchoring the chaotic textures of the cards and smoke
coreInvariants: Chiaroscuro lighting with visible blind slats

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright playing cards on the table.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the yellow top text, moves down to the subject's face, follows the arm to the cards, and ends at the white bottom script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black borders and deep shadows on the left side of the frame create a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and skin tones (subject and lighting)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the deep blacks and the bright highlights on the subject and text.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Sharp, angular, all-caps print with varying stroke widths
Bottom text: Fluid, connected cursive script with long descenders
Both styles appear hand-drawn with a marker or brush
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' in the top text has an elongated, sweeping leg
The 'g' in the bottom text has an exaggerated, loopy descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between aggressive, angular print and soft, flowing cursive.
graphicDevices: Underline stroke beneath the top text
Thick black border framing the central photograph

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, immediate energy of the top text
Matches the personal, handwritten feel of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, low-key photograph of a man in a white t-shirt sitting at a table with playing cards and bottles. Use side-lighting through venetian blinds to create horizontal shadow patterns. Frame the image with a thick black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, neon yellow angular lettering at the top and fluid white cursive script at the bottom, ensuring the letters slightly overlap the image area.

verificationChecks: Are the venetian blind shadows clearly visible on the background?
Is the top text neon yellow and the bottom text white?
Is there a thick black border around the central image?
Does the typography look hand-drawn rather than typeset?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the venetian blind shadows
Color of the top display text
Subject's pose and props on the table
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between subject and background
Ensure the horizontal shadow lines are consistent
Verify the yellow text has an underline element
Confirm the bottom text is in a cursive script style
recipe.reuseFormula: Noir Lighting + Venetian Blind Shadows + Black Border + Dual-Style Hand Lettering
